# Monterey Golf Tours

> Custom Monterey Peninsula golf trips planned end to end. We handle tee times, lodging, and logistics for groups of 2–300 players across the peninsula's public, resort, and Pebble Beach Resorts® courses.

## About
Monterey Golf Tours (montereygolftours.com) is a golf trip planning service founded by Sean Schaeffer. We specialize in multi-day golf packages on the Monterey Peninsula — Monterey, Carmel, Carmel Valley, Pacific Grove, Seaside, and the Pebble Beach area. We do not sell individual tee times; we plan complete trips. As an IAGTO-contracted travel partner with Pebble Beach Resorts®, we can book and name Pebble Beach Golf Links®, Spyglass Hill Golf Course®, Del Monte Golf Course®, and The Hay™. The Links at Spanish Bay® is currently closed for renovation, reopening April 17, 2027 — see below.

## Courses We Feature
- Bayonet — Seaside, CA. Par 72, 7,024 yards, rating 74.8, slope 139. Designer: Gen. Robert B. McClure (1954), redesigned by Gene Bates (2007). Ranked No. 35 nationally by Golf Digest among the toughest public courses in the United States. Built on the former Fort Ord military base.
- Black Horse — Seaside, CA. Par 72, 7,024 yards, slope 141, rating 73.7. Sister course to Bayonet at the former Fort Ord facility. Sweeping Monterey Bay views.
- Carmel Valley Ranch Golf Course — Carmel Valley, CA. Par 70, 6,117 yards. Pete Dye design — his only course in Northern California.
- Quail Lodge & Golf Club — Carmel Valley, CA. Par 71, 6,500 yards, slope 129. Robert Muir Graves (1964).
- Laguna Seca Golf Ranch — Monterey, CA. Par 71, 6,226 yards, rating 70.7, slope 129. Accessible daily-fee course close to downtown Monterey.
- Pacific Grove Golf Links — Pacific Grove, CA. Par 70, 5,727 yards. Municipal course with ocean-adjacent holes at accessible pricing.
- Poppy Hills Golf Course — Pebble Beach, CA (Del Monte Forest). Par 71, 7,091 yards (Jones tees). NCGA-owned — not affiliated with Pebble Beach Company. Robert Trent Jones II design.
- The Club at Pasadera — Monterey, CA. Par 71, 6,673–6,733 yards. Jack Nicklaus Signature Design (2000). Private, limited public access.
- Pasatiempo Golf Course — Santa Cruz, CA. Par 70, 6,473 yards, rating 72.7, slope 143. Alister MacKenzie (1929) — his home course.
- Pebble Beach Golf Links® — Pebble Beach, CA. Par 72, 6,802 yards. Jack Neville and Douglas Grant (1919).
- Spyglass Hill Golf Course® — Pebble Beach, CA. Par 72, 6,960 yards, rating 75.4, slope 145. Robert Trent Jones Sr.
- The Links at Spanish Bay® — Pebble Beach, CA. Par 72, 6,726 yards. True links-style course. CLOSED for a Gil Hanse-led renovation as of March 18, 2026; confirmed to reopen April 17, 2027. Not currently bookable.
- Del Monte Golf Course® — Monterey, CA. Par 72, 6,356 yards, rating 71.8, slope 129. Opened 1897 — the oldest golf course in continuous use west of the Mississippi.
- The Hay™ — Pebble Beach, CA. Par 27, 670 yards, 9-hole short course. Originally 1957, redesigned by Tiger Woods and TGR Design (2021).

## Lodging We Feature
- Hyatt Regency Monterey Hotel & Spa (560 rooms, Monterey) — sits directly on Del Monte Golf Course®
- Carmel Valley Ranch (179 all-suites, Carmel Valley) — on-site Pete Dye golf course
- Quail Lodge & Golf Club (93 rooms, Carmel Valley) — on-site golf course
- Bernardus Lodge & Spa (73 rooms, Carmel Valley) — guest access to The Club at Pasadera
- Monterey Plaza Hotel & Spa (285 rooms, Monterey) — Forbes Four-Star, Cannery Row
- InterContinental The Clement Monterey (208 rooms, Monterey) — Cannery Row, next to the Monterey Bay Aquarium
- Portola Hotel & Spa (379 rooms, Monterey) — downtown, connected to the Monterey Conference Center
- L'Auberge Carmel, Relais & Châteaux (20 rooms, Carmel-by-the-Sea)
- Casa Munras Garden Hotel & Spa (163 rooms, Monterey) — Monterey's first hotel, since 1824

## Sample Itineraries
- 3-Day Monterey Golf Weekend — 3 rounds. For casual golfer groups, weekend escapes, 4–8 players. Pacific Grove + Poppy Hills + Laguna Seca. From custom quote.
- 4-Day Classic Peninsula — 4 rounds. For serious golfer groups, bucket-list trips, 4–12 players. Bayonet + Pacific Grove + Carmel Valley Ranch + Poppy Hills. Base: Hyatt Regency Monterey.
- 5-Day Full Peninsula — 5 rounds. For avid golfer groups wanting every key course, 4–12 players. Bayonet + Black Horse + Carmel Valley Ranch + Poppy Hills + Pasatiempo. Base: Portola Hotel.
- 7-Day Ultimate Monterey — 6–7 rounds. For golf enthusiasts wanting everything, 2–8 players. Full peninsula including Pebble Beach Golf Links®. Base: Lodge at Pebble Beach or Hyatt.
- Carmel Valley Golf Getaway — 3 rounds over 3 days. Fog-free morning golf at Carmel Valley Ranch + Quail Lodge + one coastal round. Base: Carmel Valley Ranch resort.
- The Pebble Pilgrimage — 4 rounds, 4 days. Pebble Beach Golf Links® + Spyglass Hill® + Del Monte® + one value course. For serious bucket-list groups. IAGTO rates apply.
- Monterey Corporate Golf Outing — 1–2 days, 20–200 players. Bayonet (challenge day format). Client events, team building, incentive trips. Full event coordination included.
- Best Value Peninsula Trip — 3 rounds, 3 days. Pacific Grove + Laguna Seca + Black Horse. Budget-conscious groups, 4–8 players. Base: Casa Munras or Portola Hotel.

## Booking
All trips are custom-quoted — no fixed prices shown. Request a quote at https://montereygolftours.com/quote/ and receive options within 24 hours. Minimum group size: 2 players.

## Special Access
As an IAGTO-contracted partner, Monterey Golf Tours can book Pebble Beach Resorts® courses (Pebble Beach Golf Links®, Spyglass Hill® Golf Course, Del Monte Golf Course®, The Hay™) at IAGTO rates. The Links at Spanish Bay® is currently closed for a Gil Hanse-led renovation; reopening April 17, 2027 — waitlist available at https://montereygolftours.com/golf-courses/links-at-spanish-bay/
